title: DropdownServerSideItem configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.DropdownServerSideItemAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to.
